additions.reason: The Torah uses explicit bechina language to identify אמת as 'רגל שלישי' (the third leg): 'וּבְחִינַת אֱמֶת הַזֶּה הוּא בְּחִינַת רֶגֶל שְׁלִישִׁי'. This is a direct identity statement — truth IS the third leg. The third leg is the support (סעד) that stabilizes the beginner-walker. Since אמת = שבת = רגל שלישי by the chain of bechina statements in this Torah, the concept רגל שלישי belongs in Package 1 as a third expression of the same supportive, stabilizing nature.

additions.reason: The Torah explicitly states: 'וְהַסַּעַד הַזֶּה הוּא בְּחִינַת אֱמֶת' — the support IS an aspect of truth. This is a bechina statement: the supportive act that stabilizes the beginner-walker shares the same essential nature as truth and Shabbat. It is not that truth produces support (eitza) — rather, they are the same stabilizing quality viewed from two angles (structural support vs. truthful grounding). סעד belongs in Package 1 alongside שבת and אמת.

This is a bechina equivalence: the future sun = the light of the seven days. Both are the same transcendent luminosity that Shabbat charity embodies. אור שבעת הימים is another name for the שמש-צדקה of Shabbat — the same essential solar nature but at its maximal, future-oriented expression. Belongs in Package 2.

additions.reason: The Torah identifies ימי החול (weekdays) as a period of שליטת החיצונים (dominion of the external/impure forces), and their specific mode of control is blocking 'בחינות רגלין' (the legs/walking). The Chitzonim are the evil counterpart to שבת and אמת: on Shabbat they have zero power ('אין להם שליטה כלל'), while on weekdays they reign. They are the direct negative mirror of Package 1 — שבת=אמת is the force that defeats them, and they are the force that prevents proper walking. This is an implicit evil-polarity node. Note: no bechina edge for this node exists in the dataset for Torah 86; this is a gap addition identifying the evil dimension of the Torah that is present in the text but unencoded.

additions.reason: The Torah explicitly contrasts ימי החול (weekdays) with שבת: the weekdays are when the Chitzonim rule and the legs are weakened, while Shabbat restores the power of walking. ימי החול is a structural bechina-equivalent concept to the domain of restriction and impurity (as opposed to Shabbat = truth = the liberated state). The text uses 'בימי החול' as a technical term for the state of spiritual diminishment. It is neutral-polarity (a time-period that can be sanctified or not) but in this Torah functions as the negative pole of the Shabbat-truth axis.
